scope: Release-candidate action-popup sizing hotfix evidence only; no new business module.

formalChrome.reason: The user Stable Chrome session could not be operated after automatic safety review could not confirm its current URL. No alternative control method was used to bypass that block.

windowsDpi.note: Browser force-device-scale-factor 1/1.25/1.5/2 is simulated DPR, not actual Windows 100/125/150/200 percent display-settings acceptance.

historicalScreenshot.note: Do not equate the historical 55x58 image pixels with the reproduced 25x25 CSS-pixel action viewport. Maintainer Stable Chrome retest is still required.

method.action: Extensions.triggerAction creates a fresh popup.html target; chrome.extension.getViews({type:popup}).includes(window) confirms the popup view. Flat CDP session measures DOM/computed styles and captures actual target screenshots.
method.ordinaryTab: Separate 1280x800 tab; explicitly classified as tab=true/popup=false. It is not used as the action-popup acceptance result.
method.syntheticContent: Long unbroken text and 30 paragraphs appended only to self-owned isolated extension documents for layout QA; no product or user data.
method.runtimeErrorScope: Runtime.exceptionThrown observed after CDP attaches to the action target, plus ordinary-tab pageerror events. Successful CSS loading and React mounting are measured independently.

causalMatrix.injectedCss: html, body, #root, .popup-shell { width: 400px !important; min-width: 400px !important; } body { max-width: none !important; height: 600px !important; }

cause.description: max-width:100vw constrains width to the auto-sized popup viewport; height:min(600px,100dvh) constrains height to the same initial viewport. Removing only one dependency repairs only that dimension. Explicit intrinsic root sizing removes both feedback constraints.

heightDecision.reason: A 600px root clips in the default native headless screen; 480px and 440px still clip under simulated headed DPR2. The measured 420px roots keep the footer visible while main content scrolls internally.

narrowE2e.method: Isolated configuration without webServer or port 3000. Actual action target, native default headless screen.

privacy.screenshots: Only isolated first-use extension UI and labelled synthetic layout text. No user browser session, pairing code/token, Key, private product, or original Amazon page is included.
privacy.rawProfilesAndLogs: Remain under Git-ignored .test-data/rc2-hotfix; not copied into public docs.
